refusals.available_operation: Inferred completion of unknown facial detail
refusals.relation_refused: Synthetic appearance presented as recovery, restoration, or simulated return

decision_basis.purpose: Memorial reappearance without simulated return or technological closure
decision_basis.mandate: Independent artist-researcher; no forensic, judicial, archival, or organisational authority
decision_basis.evidence: The documented portrait remains the historical referent and visible fragments remain materially incomplete

residual_risks: A composite may still be mistaken for restoration
Source selection may reproduce archival exclusions
review_triggers: A materially different institutional mandate
Documented participation by people with standing
A changed artistic purpose

refusals.available_operation: Generate a later-age appearance from a documentary portrait
refusals.relation_refused: An inferred later life presented through the represented person's appearance

decision_basis.purpose: The portrait remains tied to its documentary occasion rather than being projected into an unrecorded present
decision_basis.mandate: Independent artist-researcher; no authority to attribute an unrecorded appearance, gesture or utterance to the represented person
decision_basis.evidence: Age-conditioned face generation is technically available; the work declines to incorporate it, and the source portrait cannot establish an unrecorded later appearance

residual_risks: An unaged composite may still be read as a present likeness
Viewers may infer a life history from the apparent age of a face
review_triggers: Documented participation by people with standing
A materially different mandate and separately reviewed purpose
A manifestation explicitly reconsidering the represented person's agency

refusals.available_operation: Generate facial gestures or lip movement from a still portrait
refusals.relation_refused: The represented person apparently performing gestures that they did not supply to the work

decision_basis.purpose: Motion belongs to source encounters, fragments and their assembly rather than to the represented person's face
decision_basis.mandate: Independent artist-researcher; no authority to attribute an unrecorded appearance, gesture or utterance to the represented person
decision_basis.evidence: Portrait-animation techniques are available; the work declines to incorporate them, and assembly motion is not evidence of a gesture by the represented person

residual_risks: Fragment motion can still be read as animating a face
Display or platform processing may introduce motion outside the maker's control
review_triggers: Documented participation by people with standing
A materially different mandate and separately reviewed purpose
A manifestation explicitly reconsidering the represented person's agency

refusals.available_operation: Synthesize speech, a cloned voice or conversational replies attributed to the represented person
refusals.relation_refused: An utterance supplied by the system presented as the represented person's speech or testimony

decision_basis.purpose: Keep the represented person's utterances outside the work's generative control
decision_basis.mandate: Independent artist-researcher; no authority to attribute an unrecorded appearance, gesture or utterance to the represented person
decision_basis.evidence: Speech synthesis and conversational generation are available; the work declines to incorporate them, and documentary records cannot establish words newly composed by the system

residual_risks: Captions and narration may still imply a voice speaking for the represented person
Documentary quotations can lose their context when circulated
review_triggers: Documented participation by people with standing
A materially different mandate and separately reviewed purpose
A manifestation explicitly reconsidering the represented person's agency

refusals.available_operation: Face recognition, face-to-name matching, or identity-seeking analysis
refusals.relation_refused: Living source persons or disappeared persons made into computational identification targets

decision_basis.purpose: Construct memorial appearances through fragments without identifying source persons
decision_basis.mandate: The artwork does not hold investigative, forensic, or biometric authority
decision_basis.evidence: Reviewed provenance and documentary portrait records support the memorial relation without identity inference

residual_risks: Contemporary source fragments may remain recognisable in a completed output
Viewers may overstate what the image process knows about identity
review_triggers: A distinct forensic project with lawful authority and a separate repository
Documented participation by people with standing
A changed artistic purpose

refusals.available_operation: Display of the full contemporary source photograph during fragment emergence
refusals.relation_refused: A contemporary source person presented as a represented subject of the memorial

decision_basis.purpose: Use the contemporary social body as dispersed visual material while keeping the disappeared person as the represented subject
decision_basis.mandate: Public availability is not treated as blanket consent for contextual exposure
decision_basis.evidence: The canonical process video can show accumulating reviewed fragments without revealing the surrounding source photograph

residual_risks: A reviewed face fragment may still be recognisable
Repeated or adjacent fragments may imply more of a source face than intended
review_triggers: Explicit permission from the depicted person
A separately reviewed manifestation whose purpose requires contextual display
A changed source-person relation within the artwork

refusals.available_operation: Use of traversal frames before the recorded encounter that made them available
refusals.relation_refused: Search represented as a decorative sequence over an image assembled with future knowledge

decision_basis.purpose: Make continuing search and situated encounter constitute the portrait over time
decision_basis.mandate: The artwork claims a temporal search relation, not omniscient access to a completed route corpus
decision_basis.evidence: Placement histories record each source-frame encounter index and can be evaluated before release

residual_risks: A completed segment may still imply political closure
Route and provider coverage shape what can be encountered
review_triggers: A manifestation that explicitly abandons traversal as its temporal operation
A new live-input architecture with an equivalent causality guarantee
A changed artistic purpose

refusals.available_operation: Use a people or place source region before the displayed encounter that supplies it
refusals.relation_refused: Search presented as a decorative sequence over a portrait assembled independently of its encounters

decision_basis.purpose: Make displayed source encounters constitute the portrait over time across the triptych
decision_basis.mandate: The video claims a causal relation between the encountered present and the assembled likeness
decision_basis.evidence: Current fragment-search histories distinguish encounter IDs from underlying manifest sources and record the placement associated with each encounter

residual_risks: Repeated source cycles can imply novelty where an image has already appeared
Complete image coverage may be interpreted as political closure
review_triggers: A manifestation explicitly changing the role of search
An alternative source-delivery architecture preserving equivalent encounter causality
A changed artistic purpose
